correctness.rationale: Given four independent arclength-uniform boundary points conditioned on crossing, the four cyclic gaps are Dirichlet(1,1,1,1), with independent uniform normalized opposite-gap splits at a fixed acute angle t. Explicit signed line offsets and linear intersection equations give 1-R^2=[cos(tU)-cos(t)][cos((pi-t)V)-cos(pi-t)]/sin^2t. The product yields all fixed-angle deficiency moments and the exact CDF. Elliptic quadratic expansion near U=V=0 gives center coefficient pi sin t/[2t(pi-t)]; the positive independent endpoint densities give the boundary eps log(1/eps) coefficient 2/[t(pi-t)]. These hold for fixed interior 0<t<pi/2, not uniformly at t=0. Independent moment checks agree at three nondegenerate angles; this also matches the prior marked joint density.
